description: Australian Climate Service is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Climate Service. The website of the Australian Climate Service, providing information and data about threats posed by a changing climate and natural hazards. Includes a number of interactive maps showing risks posed to social, built, economic and natural environments. Also includes information about climate change modelling. Maps include demographic data and agricultural data at the SA2 level. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and climate adaptation planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
